description: Tutorial example 6: Car-Parrinello molecular dynamics of Si8 with 2x2x2 k-points (PBE, 25 Ry; Gamma-only sampling of this small cell makes distorted structures lower in energy than diamond). Stage 1 converges the electrons; stage 2 runs 500 steps of 10 a.u. (0.24 fs) with a Nose thermostat at 1000 K.

checks.reference: 2026-09-28; energy after 500 MD steps (trajectory-dependent, loose tolerance); conserved energy drift 2e-4 H -- re-checked 2026-10-03 with the corrected functionals and CODATA 2018 constants
